full_judgment: 3. The opposite party Nos. 1-3 as plaintiffs filed S.C.C. suit No.4 of 1998 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, 1st Court, Bogra praying for a decree for ejectment of the defendant no.1    (opposite party no.4) and these defendant petitioners (defendant Nos. 2 and 3 in the suit ) from the suit premises (shop No.12) measuring an area of .0250 Shahasrangsha appertaining to plot No. 1392, 'M.R.R. Khatian No. 190 of mouza Sutrapur within Police Station and District Bogra on the allegation that the plaintiffs purchased the suit premises from one Jalilur Rahman and the defendant no.1 was a tenant (Bharatia); that the defendant No.1 paid rent up-to November, 1986 who used to pay rent irregularly as a habitual defaulter in paying rent; that the defendant No.1 handed over possession of the suit premises in favour of defendant Nos.2 'and 3 in November, 1996 without taking any consent from the plaintiff-opposite parties and the plaintiffs did not accept them' to be their tenants; that defendant Nos.2 and 3 happens to be the sub-letees under the defendant no. 1 who started depositing rent with the House Rent Controller vide House Rent case no. 28 of 1997. The suit premises being an old one, the plaintiffs want to develop the same and consequently, the plaintiffs served notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act upon the defendant no.1 requesting to hand over possession or the suit premises in their favour on 31st March, 1998 , who received the same on or before 23.3.1998 but the defendant No.1 did not hand over the possession of the suit premises in favour of the plaintiffs and hence the suit.
